text:
maria.p: Quick internal note — Realtime Toolcall v2 and the HorizonXN family (xn-small, xn-medium, xn-large) are going GA for hosted API today. Also enabling Adaptive Degradation routing by default for new orgs. :tada:

jeff: Congrats! What does Adaptive Degradation do?

maria.p: Short version: when a primary route shows sustained tail latency or backend errors, the system will degrade gracefully to a compatible variant (lower-precision model or alternate region) to preserve latency SLOs instead of failing outright. Its additive and configurable per-route.

devex: Migration guide + quickstarts: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/realtime-toolcall-v2 (internal shortlink included in the guide).

maria.p: New endpoints are additive — POST /v1/toolcall for tool-invocations and POST /v1/realtime/mux-stream for multiplexed streaming sessions. Old realtime endpoints keep working.

jeff: Any API surface changes customers need to update now?

maria.p: No breaking changes. Small deprecation: legacy query param fallback=false will be removed in 60 days. New opt-out header is x-rw-routing-mode: "no-degrade". We also added a client-side hint header x-rw-priority: "latency|cost|throughput" to influence routing. See docs for examples.

ops-bot: release 1912.01 deployed by maria.p  canary 4% traffic in us-east-1. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1912.01

eng-oncall: Oncall will monitor the canary for 72h. Alert criteria: p95 > baseline * 1.4 OR error-rate > 2x baseline triggers investigation/rollback. Tag #eng-oncall for anything urgent.

support: Weve got canned responses ready and an internal playbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/toolcall-v2. Support triage doc includes sample repros and suggested workarounds.

devex: Quick curl streaming mux example:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-rw-routing-mode: prefer-degrade" \
  -H "x-rw-priority: latency" \
  -d '{"model":"xn-medium","streams":[{"id":"s1","input":"hi"},{"id":"s2","input":"fetch tool"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/mux-stream
```
And Node snippet in the guide shows how to attach tool handlers for /v1/toolcall.

product: Well publish the external release note after the first canary health check (EOD). Marketing + CS already looped — customer-facing FAQ will cover upgrade paths and headers.

jeff: Rollout plan?

maria.p: Canary 4% today, ramp to 25% over 48 hours if metrics stable, full NA/EU sweep over 7 days. Well gate APAC start on NA/EU health signals.

product: Changelog entry created: https://redwood.ai/internal/changelog#1912.01 — tagging release assets and docs.

support: Ill run a small smoke test suite against the canary and post results in the rollout board.

maria.p: Appreciate it — please file any regressions in the rollout board and tag eng-oncall. Thanks everyone :rocket:
